dedupe_keys.name: unesco ihp wins water information network system catalogue of water spatial datasets

description: IHP-WINS, the Water Information Network System of UNESCO's Intergovernmental Hydrological Programme, is an open catalogue of water-related spatial data. When read the catalogue listed 434 spatial data sets and a few documents, most under the INSPIRE theme hydrography, with filters by country group (El Salvador, Honduras, Guatemala, Kenya, Ethiopia, Montenegro, Albania, the Gulf countries), by publisher (mostly IHP, the UNESCO Nairobi office, IGRAC, NASA and UNOSAT) and by tag, including groundwater, wastewater infrastructure and wastewater treatment plants. Formats include shapefiles (340), PDF, CSV, GeoTIFF, JSON and GeoJSON. Coverage is global, with clusters in Central America, East Africa and the Western Balkans. Access is free to browse and download; registration is offered for contributors. Caveats: most records carry limited metadata (310 of 442), licences vary by dataset, and the catalogue mixes national layers with project outputs. Simulation uses: national water resource and water infrastructure layers for exposure and planning studies where national portals are thin. Related records: national water infrastructure layers on HDX (data-hdx-national-water-infrastructure-layers) and FAO AQUASTAT (data-fao-aquastat-main-database).
